firConsentText:
We are enabling Cross Border Inward Remittances on UPI platform. During Foreign Inward Remittance (FIR) transaction , for validation purpose, we will share your details i.e., Name and Account Number, in case sender inputs your UPI ID for sending funds to you. These details will be shared with International Remittance Partner (IRP), however the sender will only be able to see your name in partially masked format during validation. Please note that if you do not wish to share your details, you will not be able to receive funds through this platform. Kindly click SUBMIT button to provide consent.

Note: With this consent, we will be marking this account as default to receive the Foreign inward remittance.
